files.legend.sop:
@legend.ui.avatar core.legend
    namespace=ui.avatar
    version=0.3.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="The avatar: one face drawn from the parts of the knowledge world k.faces (slots with anchor boxes, variants with plain features, presets, expressions, colours). The state is the name and the choices (a variant for each slot, four face colours, adjustments of size and place, the expression); the data is read from the catalog by the host."

@ui.avatar.face core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="The face and its name. The world state holds name and face (slots, colours, paint, adj, expression, base, saved faces, undo history)."
    example="Put on a hat."

@ui.avatar.face.name core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="What is your name?"

Platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."
